# Feno

> > Feno is the world's first AI-powered Smartbrush, revolutionizing oral health care with intelligent brushing technology and real-time health monitoring.

Feno offers innovative smart oral care solutions including the Smartbrush with AI-powered brushing guidance, multiple product bundles for different user needs, and professional-grade options for dental experts. The platform combines cutting-edge health-tech with accessible consumer products, backed by media coverage from major publications like The Verge and Wired Magazine.
